headline: 尚比亞總統尋求連任
context: 尚比亞總統哈欽勒瑪（Hakainde Hichilema）在首都盧薩卡（Lusaka）投下自己的選票，尋求第二個任期。持續的生活成本壓力，讓他的支持度受到影響。

sources.name: BBC
sources.summary: Hakainde Hichilema wants five more years but continued cost of living pressures have dented his appeal.
sources.title: Zambians voting as president bids for second term

sources.name: Al Jazeera
sources.summary: Zambian president Hakainde Hichilema has cast his vote in the capital Lusaka, as he bids for a second term.
sources.title: Zambian president Hichilema votes as he seeks second term

thread_text:
尚比亞總統哈欽勒瑪（Hakainde Hichilema），在首都盧薩卡（Lusaka）投下自己的選票，尋求第二個五年任期。

持續的生活成本壓力，讓他的支持度打了折扣。

—— 本則整理自 BBC、Al Jazeera 於 2026 年 8 月 13 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
